'''Upside''' was the name of a small [[Shipyard/Legends|dockyard]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belgaroth]]. It appeared over Belgaroth a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the arrival of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the planet and served to inspect Imperial ships involved in the test ranges on the [[Tyrel|nearby]] [[Tregan|moons]] or during military maneuvers. However, the size of the Upside barely allowed for the accommodation of a single [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="CW" />

[[12 BBY/Legends|Twelve years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], command of the repair yard was assumed by [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Brivyl Goss]]. However, just two years later, he received orders to destroy the orbital station and evacuate from the planet. Instead of carrying out the order, Goss selected several trusted junior officers and left the [[Belgaroth system/Legends|star system]] aboard a requisitioned [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Nevertheless, the Upside continued to orbit Belgaroth even after the formation of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The station was used for routine repairs and maintenance of the few ships that entered the Belgaroth system. This, fortunately, was enough to sustain the local economy – albeit at a minimal level.<ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Upside space station was conceived in the sourcebook [[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]] {{C|[[2003]]}} for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] by [[Wizards of the Coast]]. In the informational section about the planet [[Belgaroth]], a brief entry is provided about the station and other locations associated with the planet.
